params.label: Kick source
params.note: Stem: the set's own kick group stem. Synth: the phone's kick synth alone (the stem is muted). Both: the two together. A/B: stem and synth take turns, a bar each. Switches on the next beat.

params.label: Synth level
params.note: At 0 dB the synth's kick sits at the stem's level, so Stem and Synth compare at one loudness.

params.label: Sample layer
params.note: One of HW002's own kick hits, cut from the set's kick stem, on every beat on top of whatever else plays.

params.label: Pitch start
params.note: Where the body's sine starts. Measured on HW002's kick: about 200 Hz 40 ms in, so it starts near 400 Hz.

params.label: Pitch end
params.note: The note the body lands on. HW002's kick falls to about 48-50 Hz. Lower is more deep sub (the 25-40 Hz the references have).

params.label: Pitch fall
params.note: How fast the pitch falls (the time to fall two thirds of the way). HW002's kick: about 46 ms.

params.label: Body hold
params.note: How long the body stays at full level. HW002's kick swells until just before the offbeat (about 190 ms), then stops.

params.label: Decay curve
params.note: Low: the body stays loud and stops short. High: it falls away fast, like a dying boom.

params.label: 052 grit
params.note: In the set Clubby 052 has its own COLDFIRE, before its transient shaper: the hit's own distortion, where its 1-8 kHz bite comes from.

params.label: Offbeat hits
params.note: The set's drum rack has an offbeat pad: a short knock on every off-8th, at the offbeat layer's level.

params.label: Rumble tail
params.note: The synth's rumble is the kick's tail through a dark room. Longer: more wash between the kicks.

params.label: Rumble duck
params.note: LFOTool on the rumble: how far it dips under each kick. 100%: silent on the beat, swelling back before the next.
